_arch_note: exp_n_0121 (nap8/tph128, 1.1914552 at 67,351,692 params over 16k) with the FFN LUT slot replaced by a PURE HyperplaneMHL at the full model dimension -- NO compress Linear and NO decompress Linear. exp_n_0121 wrapped its FastMHL in a sandwich (compress 384 -> H*48, per-head LUT over 48 dims, decompress H*48 -> 384), so its cells stored 48-dim vectors. Here the LUT reads the full 384-dim input and every table cell stores a full 384-dim output: table params = n_heads * tph * 2^nap * n_outputs with n_outputs 48 -> 384, an 8x growth (37,748,736 -> 301,989,888). The hyperplanes are correspondingly [n_tables, nap, 384] instead of [n_tables, nap, 48]: each table picks its row via nap learned affine sign tests 1[<w_i,x>+b_i>0] on the FULL input. See local_hyperplane_ffn.py; shared src/spiky/lutorch/ untouched. Structural knobs held to exp_n_0121 where they still apply: n_heads 4, nap 8 (256 cells), tph 128, untied head, forward_mode hard, learnable_temps, init noise 1e-3, base seed 1000, depth 6, n_embd 384, n_head 6, seq 512, vocab 32768, lr 3e-4, wd 0.1, seed 1. hyperplane_init=anchor_pairs reproduces each anchor pair exactly at step 0 (w = e_a - e_b, b = 0, no noise). SUPERSEDES exp_g_0029_SUPERSEDED_hyperplane_in_sandwich, which kept the sandwich and swapped only the inner filling -- that build left the tables at 37.7M and total at +1.79%, which was not the intent; it was stopped at step 800 and is retained as a record.
_no_sandwich_note: lut_inner_in_dim and lut_inner_out_dim are -1, the codebase's existing sentinel for 'no projection'. That is the whole architectural change and it is what drives the parameter jump. One consequence worth stating: exp_n_0121's FFN slot output was EXACTLY zero at step 0 because train.py zero-initializes decompress.weight. With no decompress there is nothing to zero, so this slot starts at the LUT tables' own init noise -- a sum of n_heads*tph = 512 cells each Uniform[-1e-3, 1e-3], std ~0.013 per output dim. Small against LayerNorm'd activations but not identically zero. Inherent to removing the projection, not a choice. A second consequence: with no per-head compress every head reads the same x (the joint topology) and head outputs are summed; without a compress there are no per-head slices to hand out, and HyperplaneMHL has no multi_head_input mode.
_mem_note: device_batch_size 12 / grad_accum 4 inherited from exp_n_0121 (effective batch 24,576 tokens). This is a much bigger model than the parent and the soft backward must produce gradients for hyperplane_weight [n_tables, nap, 384] and the 384-dim cells, so memory was re-verified before launch with a smoke that mirrors a REAL training step -- the full grad_accum=4 micro-batch loop on real data, plus a real evaluate_bpb -- not single micro-batches, which is the trap that let exp_g_0028 pass a smoke and then OOM before step 1. Escalation ladder if it OOMs: expandable_segments:True first, then device_batch 12 -> 6 with grad_accum 4 -> 8 to preserve the effective batch. Whatever the smoke passes in is the environment the run launches in.
